title: Better CPS
description: A customizable CPS counter with an optional WASD + mouse keystrokes overlay.
body:
# Better CPS

Track your **clicks per second** in style, with an optional keystrokes display for content and PvP.

## ✨ Features
- ⚡ Live **CPS counter** — adjustable position & RGB colour
- ⌨️ Optional **Keystrokes overlay** — WASD + LMB/RMB boxes that light up as you press, with left/right CPS
- 🪶 Lightweight, client-side

Configure it through **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)**. Requires **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**.
